protocol.purpose: Exploratory statistical explanation of Basic detection: count-distribution shape, bin contributions, marginal bias maps, cross-cell dependence diagnostics and spatial arrangement
protocol.selection_disclosure: Mechanism questions are informed by the inspected detection-rate results. This is a post hoc diagnostic reanalysis, not independent confirmation or a preregistered cryptographic causal claim. Statistical code/plan are frozen before main mechanism outputs; preflight uses synthetic data only.
protocol.keys: All nine frozen confirmation keys; default control separate from eight random keys
protocol.descriptive_scope: All 54 key/N/round conditions. Per-replica histogram expectations remain 4096*Bin(N,1/2) bin masses; pooling repetitions never changes N to 500N in this histogram null.
protocol.bin_decomposition: For O_b per-replica counts, E_b=4096*p_b: mean Pearson contribution equals (mean O_b-E_b)^2/E_b + mean[(O_b-mean O_b)^2]/E_b. Population divisor R is used for the exact identity, not for an unbiased variance estimate. Ideal iid-cell expected total is 7, with shape 7/R and scatter 7*(R-1)/R.
protocol.maps: p_hat_ij=sum K_ij/(R*N); archive signed bias maps and exact pooled binomial SAC-marginal tests. Bonferroni 0.05/(54*4096)=0.05/221184; no coordinate independence assumed. This fixed-map SAC-marginal null differs from the original ideal-permutation reference. Do not publish underflowed numerical p-values as mathematical zeros.
protocol.squared_bias: Unbiased per-cell estimate of (p-1/2)^2 is [(T-M/2)^2-M/4]/[M*(M-1)], M=RN. Average before taking a nonnegative display square root; archive negative estimates. Raw squared-bias effective-cell counts include estimation noise and are descriptive.
protocol.replay: Regenerate the default key's 500 existing input replications using the frozen confirmation evaluator. Verify all 3000 original matrix hashes (both N, rounds 6-8), retain full matrices for the three default cases. There are no new cipher input replications; replay computations are not independent evidence.
protocol.empirical_dependence_identity: On the full 500 default matrices, estimate each cell's bin probabilities pi_cb. Independent product-of-empirical-marginals scatter is sum_c pi_cb*(1-pi_cb)/E_b. Actual scatter minus this quantity is the signed net empirical cross-cell covariance term. Mean Basic = shape + independent scatter + covariance term; it is a finite-sample algebraic diagnostic, not causal identification.
protocol.split: Replicas 0-249 train marginal surrogates; 250-499 evaluate actual holdout statistics. These are previously collected data; the split is a predictive diagnostic, not a new independently collected validation set.
protocol.surrogate_rule: Fair: independent Bin(N,1/2) cells. Fitted: independent Bin(N,p_hat_train_ij) cells, using coordinate MLEs from 250*N flips. Empirical: each cell independently resamples its own count among the 250 training matrices. Both fitted models remove between-cell dependence and preserve different approximations to marginal behavior. Parameter-estimation uncertainty and model misspecification limit interpretation.
protocol.decision_rule: Reuse unchanged match_count_nonrandom, bank 0: Count exact original rule, histogram plus-one target equal to Count's actual ideal-label size. No new calibration. Report all four detectors. Model Wilson intervals condition on fitted distributions; they omit fit uncertainty. The 10000 fair draws are not a new accurate rare-tail calibration study.
protocol.layout_rule: Independently permute all 4096 cell positions of each of the 250 holdout matrices 40 times. Basic and Count must be exactly invariant. Quantify changes to Row/Column. This rearranges observations, not cipher outputs. Repeated permutations are clustered within the 250 genuine parent replications; report parent-level paired bootstrap intervals, not iid Wilson intervals over 10000 permutations.
protocol.reporting: Full bin/condition grids, all maps, marginal PMFs, synthetic-statistic records, layout parent rates, fixed source/input hashes and precise limitations. No selection of keys/bins by performance, no retuning after outcomes. Interpret whether coherent shifts, marginal heterogeneity, covariance or spatial arrangement are supported; do not assume a diffuse weak-bias explanation in advance.
protocol.limitations: Detailed dependence/surrogate/layout diagnostics use the default key only; all-key descriptive evidence uses nine keys. Conditional Monte Carlo intervals are not simultaneous mechanism tests. Fitted surrogates cannot prove a unique cause. Position permutation does not establish that ShiftRows or S-boxes cause the effect. Shared-base versus intrinsic cipher dependence is not isolated without a separately budgeted independent-base experiment. No Word editing or new security/horizon claim.

methodological_scope: Post hoc exploratory diagnosis with exact bin identities, marginal maps, fitted-product surrogates and layout ablations; not unique cryptographic causal identification.
